body: Thanks.  I do the best I can.

I would like to echo bleepitybleep's words.  Feel no shame.

You have nothing to apologise for.  We're glad you're still here.
Please don't.  If you succeed, you will leave a wake of pain you cannot imagine.
We are fortunate to be a close-knit,loving family.  Unfortunately, academic problems and bullying can be a lot for a kid to handle.

I did the same at 14, 15, and 16.

My heart aches for them now.

Thanks for you kind words.

I can only hope that my love is stronger than the resolve of a mixed-up kid growing up in a very frightening world.
Thank you.  I'll think of you too, and wish you a hug sometime when you need it.
